FieldNotes.Comments: X-array, Surrounded 0 and 90 installed in a grassy field with soft underlying dirt. E-W llines installed on a hillside at similar altitude. N-S line installed on a gradual slope. Two track about 100 meters north. Cloudy day about 55 degrees F. House about 800 meters south. Mag cable NMC39. SOH # 39.

FieldNotes.Comments: Site undisturbed and battery alive upon arrival(12.33v). Recieved 288 hours (12 days) of data. CR'S across the site were high. Opted to install new electrodes across the site. Retrenched all lines and releveled mag. Concerned of original installation integrity. Warm day with very poor air quality. E-W dipoles are both located along very steep slopes. New battery installed (13.08v).
